theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U M₁ M₂ : Set (Eucl P)) (θ₁ θ₂ : Eucl P → ℝ) (ξ₁ ξ₂ : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) n), IsRectifiableTriple U n M₁ θ₁ ξ₁ → IsRectifiableTriple U n M₂ θ₂ ξ₂ → (∀ᵐ x ∂((μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict (M₁ ∩ M₂)), ∀ Q : Submodule ℝ (Eucl P), HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M₁ θ₁ x Q → HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M₂ θ₂ x Q) → ∀ᵐ x ∂((μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict (M₁ ∩ M₂)), ξ₁ x = ξ₂ x ∨ ξ₁ x = -ξ₂ x
